articles.title: Cardano holders are turning down a $4 million request for running its flagship event
articles.snippet: Roughly five times as much voting stake has opposed the Foundation's 2027 conference budget as has backed it, while a developer tools request filed on Nov. 16 faces almost no opposition.

articles.title: Fraudsters Used Fake Crypto Exchanges to Steal $37 Million, SEC Alleges
articles.snippet: The agency says eight Colorado-registered entities, likely run from overseas, posed as legitimate advisers and crypto platforms—even faking SEC certificates and filings—to defraud U.S. investors of more than $37 million.

articles.title: Google Gives Gemini Control of Mac Apps, But Its New AI Agent Comes With Risks
articles.snippet: Gemini's new Mac computer-use feature navigates apps, files, and websites in a separate window, but Google's own documentation warns about prompt injection.
